case.existing_material_scope: GM/Redi/ice/sponge/eta_relax/polar caps disabled by the declared original material policy, not changed by the adapter
case.other_factory_arguments: Pinned-source defaults are recorded verbatim in the implementation receipt; unresolved/default-dependent settings reject before numerical execution.
case.convection_activity_requirement: Initial density is unstable with depth under the original EOS; acceptance requires an actual nonzero instability mask and actual nonzero applied mixing term, otherwise this activity gate rejects.

adv_nsub.rule: Original factory derives this field; record and verify, never pass as a factory keyword or override it.

conv_nsub.rule: Original factory derives this field from kappa_conv=0.01, dt=0.12 and fixed native z metrics; record and verify, never pass as a keyword or override it.

factory_derived_counts.material_tracer_linear_subcycles: Computed by the unchanged original material driver and recorded at each stage; no manual replacement.

nu_nsub.rule: The explicit original factory nu_nsub keyword.

required_acceptance: native fields exact capture/restore, derived-stock roundtrip within primitive bounds, and finite/masked input refusal
same constrained wall projector in pressure transpose and flux
actual fixed-reference momentum impulse and midpoint work
default versus eager-observed original result identity
ten original stages and twelve original fast calls
per-fast native continuity using actual mean faces and separate filter change
top-three local GCL/ALE mismatch despite column closure
six-field full rollback including late failure
final original result.valid distinct from joint acceptance
each claimed active native process has a nonzero applied contribution; convection requires its actual mask and mixing term
prohibited: original CV renamed as half-prism mean CV
silently disabled coefficient or edited clock
evidence_policy: Reviewed clean committed implementation precedes bounded runs. New receipts bind actual source bytes, case/parameters and resource logs. Historical receipts remain unchanged.

reference_pressure_probe.authority: Scratch fixed-reference-mass pressure-only kick, frozen original Pa; not original combined fast-stage energy.
reference_pressure_probe.force: F0=B0.T*p with the same constrained wall projector
reference_pressure_probe.midpoint: (u_before+u_after)/2 from the actual scratch before/after arrays
reference_pressure_probe.required: nonzero impulse and independent native operator assembly
reference_pressure_probe.excluded: combined wind/rotation/fast work, continuous time-integrated pressure work, variable-mass physical Pa/PE acceptance

constructor_binding.forcing: tau_x/tau_y/Q_heat actual 2D arrays passed in the original forcing tuple; T_atm and lambda_bulk passed through their original interface

design_gate.scope: Independent pinned-source mathematical/interface design audit only; no CodeGate or numerical acceptance.
